boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten FIU spaces for studying, gaming, meeting, viewing art, and taking an outdoor break across the Modesto A. Maidique and Biscayne Bay campuses.

cards.title: Book a Station in the Esports Lounge
cards.subtitle: A reservable gaming space inside the Graham Center
cards.notes: Reserve a time slot before heading over, then use one of the lounge's 39 gaming stations for an individual or group session.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-built Graham Center lounge where active FIU students can reserve gaming time.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU describes this as a 3,042-square-foot Graham Center esports lounge with 39 gaming stations and directs active FIU students to reserve time slots.
cards.source_title: Panther Spaces | FIU Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Available to active FIU students through advance time-slot reservations; event reservations are handled by the Graham Center Main Office.

cards.title: Study Alongside Student Art and Piano Music
cards.subtitle: A Graham Center lounge behind the Welcome Center
cards.notes: Bring quiet work, browse the changing art displays, and check posted guidance before sitting down to play the shared piano.
cards.short_summary: An art-lined study and relaxation area where the FIU community can also hear or play piano.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU identifies the Piano Lounge / Art Gallery behind the Welcome Center as a place to study, relax, and view exhibitions by FIU and community artists.
cards.source_title: Panther Spaces | FIU Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: The FIU community may play the piano during designated times; consult on-site information for current availability.

cards.title: Handle a Quick Computer Task Between Classes
cards.subtitle: Seven student computers on the Graham Center's first floor
cards.notes: Use the lab for research, email, schedules, or project work; bring another payment option if your task requires printing.
cards.short_summary: A compact first-floor computer lab suited to short academic and administrative tasks.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU says the first-floor Graham Center Panther Lab gives students access to seven Alienware computers for projects, research, email, and schedules.
cards.source_title: Panther Spaces | FIU Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: FIU student access is stated; on-site printing is available for a fee. Current computer availability is not guaranteed.

cards.title: Reset With a Tabletop or Console Game
cards.subtitle: An upstairs social space in FIU's student union
cards.notes: Meet friends for table tennis, billiards, board games, or console play, and confirm the posted schedule before planning a meetup.
cards.short_summary: A shared recreation room for games, televised sports, and conversation between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU documents table tennis, video games, billiards, board games, large-screen televisions, and gathering space in the Graham Center Game Room.
cards.source_title: Panther Spaces | FIU Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: FIU currently lists Game Room hours as Monday through Friday, 10 a.m.–7 p.m., with Saturday and Sunday closed.

cards.title: Take Coursework Into an Open-Air Courtyard
cards.subtitle: An alfresco study space inside Deuxième Maison
cards.notes: Choose this courtyard when an outdoor study setting fits the weather, and keep passageways clear for others using the building.
cards.short_summary: A converted courtyard that gives Deuxième Maison an open-air place for studying and conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU's student survival guide identifies the Deuxième Maison Sky Lounge as an alfresco study space created from a former courtyard.
cards.source_title: Survival Guide | FIU Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Located in the inner courtyard of Deuxième Maison; access may follow the building's current operating conditions.

cards.title: Walk Through Three South Florida Ecosystems
cards.subtitle: An 11-acre botanical and wildlife area at MMC
cards.notes: Follow the preserve's established paths, pause to observe habitat changes, and leave plants and wildlife undisturbed during your walk.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus preserve combining walking space, wildlife habitat, and an organic garden.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU describes the 11-acre Nature Preserve as an on-campus botanical and wildlife area with three ecosystems and an organic fruit-and-vegetable garden.
cards.source_title: Campus Forests and Land Conservation | FIU College of Arts, Sciences & Education
cards.access_notes: Use designated trails and observe any posted preserve rules or temporary closures; current daily hours are not stated on the cited page.

cards.title: Read the Campus Through Its Palm Collection
cards.subtitle: More than 60 palm species with educational signs
cards.notes: Walk the signed collection slowly enough to compare leaf forms and trunks, using the labels to identify protected and uncommon species.
cards.short_summary: A campus palm collection that turns an everyday walk into a self-guided botany lesson.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU states that its Palmetum contains more than 60 palm species, including protected species, with educational signage across campus.
cards.source_title: Campus Forests and Land Conservation | FIU College of Arts, Sciences & Education
cards.access_notes: The collection is distributed on campus rather than enclosed in a single gallery; follow campus signage and standard outdoor access rules.

cards.title: Use the Museum as a Midday Art Break
cards.subtitle: FIU's free public art museum on the Avenue of the Arts
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition list, leave enough time for multiple floors, and arrive before the final hour for an unhurried gallery visit.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum where students can step into changing exhibitions without paying admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Frost Art Museum says admission is always free and open to the public and lists its location at FIU's Modesto A. Maidique Campus.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information | Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday through Sunday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Mondays and most legal and university holidays. Parking may require payment.

cards.entity_name: Green Library Seventh-Floor Quiet Study Floor
cards.title: Move Upstairs for Quiet Work
cards.subtitle: A designated quiet floor in the Green Library
cards.notes: Bring reading or focused individual work to the seventh floor, silence devices, and use a group room if discussion becomes necessary.
cards.short_summary: A clearly designated Green Library floor for students who need a quieter study environment.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU Libraries' floor information identifies the Green Library's seventh floor as a quiet study floor with general collections and group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Library Website Current Status: Normal - LibAnswers @ FIU
cards.access_notes: Located on Green Library floor seven; library entry and room use remain subject to current FIU Libraries policies and hours.

cards.title: Find a BBC Base for Solo or Group Work
cards.subtitle: Biscayne Bay Campus library with varied study settings
cards.notes: Match the task to a quiet floor, conversation floor, or group room, and reserve shared space ahead when your project requires discussion.
cards.short_summary: BBC's campus library combines quiet areas, conversational zones, and bookable group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU describes Glenn Hubert Library as a Biscayne Bay Campus study destination offering quiet floors, conversation floors, and group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Check FIU Libraries for current building hours and room-reservation requirements before traveling to Biscayne Bay Campus.
